problem:
Consider the vectors ${v}_{1}$ and ${v}_{3}$ and the block diagonal matrix $B$ shown below, where the $2\times 2$ block of $B$ represents a rotation-scaling matrix:

$$
{v}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}5+7\text{i} \\ 1+\text{i} \\ \text{i}\end{aligned}],\,{v}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ -2\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}-1 & -2 & 0 \\ 2 & -1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & -2\end{aligned}]
$$

The vectors ${v}_{1}$ and ${v}_{3}$ are the eigenvectors of a matrix $A$ corresponding to the eigenvalues ${\lambda }_{1}=-1-2\text{i}$ and ${\lambda }_{3}=-2,$  respectively. 
Given that $A=PB{P}^{-1},$ which of the following could be the matrix $P?$
